title: Chapter 32: Dolls, Dolls, Dolls
html:
Monkey was alone on the second floor, alert to every sound. He had chosen a corner with a clear view of the stairwell so nothing could approach without being seen.

The lights seemed dimmer than before, and the background music made the silence between notes feel worse. Monkey took a slow breath and tried to steady himself.

He replayed the earlier scene in his head.The timing was too perfect. That figure appeared the moment Lao Zhao noticed an eighth person among us. That can’t be a coincidence.

Everyone panicked as soon as Lao Zhao said it. If Brother Feng had managed to turn on his phone and count properly, we might have spotted the extra person. Then someone ran the moment the monster appeared, and the rest of us followed without thinking. Those were our two mistakes.

Monkey gave a quiet sigh.The costumed figure was scary, but not enough to make seven people lose their heads at once. The first person to run set everyone else off. If I’m right, that person was the eighth member. Xiao Hui followed right behind them, which would explain why I heard her scream first.

He laughed bitterly at himself. Understanding the trick did not make standing alone in a dark Haunted House any more comfortable.The performer and that eighth person were working together. Their whole strategy was psychological: split us up, keep us uncertain, then scare us one at a time. Does this boss really have to be so calculating?

Monkey was an excellent student but no braver than He San. At school, he preferred not to enter the anatomy facilities alone.I need to tell Brother Feng and the others what I figured out.

He took out his phone. Something reflected on the dark screen, and he froze.Why is that rag doll on the stairs? Didn’t we leave it on the third floor?

He kept the screen dim and angled it toward the wall. A worn rag doll was propped near the stairwell.

Maybe someone kicked it downstairs when everyone ran.That was the only explanation he could think of. The doll was stuffed with paper and fabric, not machinery, so it certainly did not look remote-controlled.It is much creepier sitting there by itself.

There was nothing extraordinary about the worn toy, yet the longer Monkey stared at it, the more strongly he felt that it was looking back. Somehow its expression reminded him of a frightened little girl asking for help.

I’m letting this place get into my head. I need to find the others and get out.He called Brother Feng. A ringtone answered from the third floor.

He’s still upstairs? Or did he drop his phone too?The distant ringing only made the Haunted House feel emptier. Monkey kept the call connected and cautiously climbed to the third floor. Brother Feng’s phone lay abandoned in the corridor.

So Brother Feng lost his phone too. I’ll have to reach someone else.Standing alone at the stairwell while half-open doors shifted in the draft, Monkey felt his knees weaken.

He was scrolling through his contacts when the phone suddenly rang in his hand.

What now?One of his classmates was calling.Shi Ling? Did she get separated too?

Monkey straightened instinctively when he saw her name. “Shi Ling? Did you get lost? Where are you? I’ll come find you.”

“I’m trapped in a room on the third floor. I didn’t see the number. Please come get me—something about this place is wrong.” Shi Ling was normally quiet and composed; hearing such panic in her voice immediately worried him.

“Slow down. How did you get trapped? I didn’t see locks on any of the doors.” Monkey started down the corridor, listening for her voice through the phone.

“I don’t know. I ran in here to hide, and now the door won’t open. And this room is different. There are two dolls sitting in the middle of the floor, side by side.”

“Dolls?” Monkey’s stomach sank. He would have been perfectly happy never seeing another one.

“Please just come get me!” Shi Ling sounded close to tears.

“I’m coming. Stay calm and don’t mess with anything until I get there.” Monkey stopped abruptly. Another rag doll was lying in the middle of the corridor less than a step away.

He swallowed the urge to shout and stared at it.

Long hair, older-looking clothes… This one is different from the doll by the stairs.The thought made him blink.Why am I assigning emotions and ages to rag dolls? This place is seriously getting to me.

Still, if this is a different doll, then the one on the stairs did not somehow follow me. That is good enough. I need to find Shi Ling.

Monkey shook his head and forced himself to focus.I’m frightening myself. If the first doll were actually following me, it would be behind me, not in front of me. This is just another trick.

To prove the point to himself, Monkey turned around.See? Nothing—

The sentence died in his throat. A rag doll sat quietly on the floor about a meter behind him.
